backend/main.mo: Motoko backend implementing user profiles, feedback submissions, access-controlled queries, and a discussion thread system with content validation.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking a header brand label update to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries for various frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based CSS defining theme variables and light/dark mode color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file that mounts the React app and loads the main entry script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React component managing client-side page routing, layout, theming, and notifications.
frontend/src/components/ContentSection.t: Simple wrapper component applying prose styling to content sections.
frontend/src/components/discussions/Comm: Renders nested comment threads with reply support and timestamp formatting.
frontend/src/components/discussions/NewC: Form for posting comments or replies with validation, authentication checks, and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/discussions/NewT: Form to create new discussion threads with validation and submission via mutation.
frontend/src/components/FeedbackForm.tsx: Feedback submission form with validation, input fields, and React Query mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/FredWelcomeIntro: Welcome/intro component for Fred chat with topic cards and a start-chat button.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Internet Identity login/logout button handling authentication state and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Layout component providing header, navigation, mobile menu, and footer with admin-aware links.
frontend/src/content/disclaimer.ts: Exports static disclaimer, legal notice, and informational text strings.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useDiscussions.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching threads and posting new threads or comments through the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, stored identities, and authentication state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching user role, profile, and feedback from the backend via the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionFlag.ts: Custom React hook that stores a boolean in sessionStorage and syncs updates automatically.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubmitFeedback.ts: React Query mutation hook that submits feedback through an actor and refreshes the feedback list.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and base typography styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React Query and Internet Identity provider before rendering the app.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Page explaining the site's purpose, legal notices, and disclaimers using styled card components.
frontend/src/pages/AdminFeedbackPage.tsx: Admin page that checks identity and role before listing or gating access to user feedback submissions.
frontend/src/pages/BeginnerGuidePage.tsx: Page presenting Clash Royale beginner concepts like elixir, towers, and basic strategy with styled sections.
frontend/src/pages/DeckTipsPage.tsx: Page listing example Clash Royale decks with details on archetypes, cards, strategies, and strengths/weaknesses.
frontend/src/pages/DiscussionsPage.tsx: Implements a discussions interface with thread listing, thread detail view, comment posting, and timestamp/comment counting utilities.
frontend/src/pages/FredChatPage.tsx: Provides a chat UI for interacting with the local Fred knowledge system, managing messages, intro display, input, and auto-scrolling.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the homepage with a hero section, informational text, official links, and an intro to Clash Royale.
frontend/src/utils/fredKnowledgeBase.ts: Defines deterministic logic for generating Fred's responses, including safety checks, greeting/thanks handling, and topic-based answers.
frontend/src/utils/fredKnowledgeTopics.t: Stores structured topic definitions for Fred, including keywords, synonyms, answers, and categories for mechanics and archetypes.
frontend/src/utils/fredMatcher.ts: Implements text normalization, synonym expansion, scoring, and topic matching for Fred’s offline Q&A system.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helper functions to read URL parameters, persist them in sessionStorage, and remove them from hash-based URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, container settings, animations, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature requirements, and known issues for the Clash Royale companion site.
